cd /tmp/obench-cell-7l9yu1r9/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_d6fdb_37; cat > /tmp/t_pp.py <<'EOF'
import sys, os, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
dist.init_process_group("gloo")
r, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
torch.manual_seed(0)
for attn in ["sdpa","eager"]:
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2, attn_implementation=attn)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    m = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref.load_state_dict(m.state_dict())
    ins = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]; tg = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(m, ins, tg, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    tot = 0
    for x,t in zip(ins,tg):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward(); tot += l.item()
    md = 0; n = 0
    for (k,p),(_,q) in zip(m.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n += 1; md = max(md, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(attn, r, "loss", loss, tot, "params w/ grad", n, "maxdiff", md)
EOF
python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=1 /tmp/t_pp.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn; python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=2 /tmp/t_pp.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn
